claim: Linear probes on residual streams of two open-weight models running mini-swe-agent decode program properties (parses, passes test suite, reduces failing tests, introduces regressions) with AUC up to 0.83, and probes predict future-edit outcomes up to about 25 steps ahead.
stance_target: L2: probes decode code correctness; occupied at agent-trajectory granularity, not at single-solution verbal-vs-probe comparison
quoted_support: Probes trained to predict the outcome of future edits (before they are materialized and written on disk) achieve performance above chance up to roughly 25 steps in advance.

breadth.confidence_families: hidden-state linear probes only (logistic regression); Section 2-3; no verbal or sampled readout found in grep of 'verbal'
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Laguna-XS.2, hidden dim d=2048 (Section 3.6 Dataset)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: not present (searched: 'base model', 'instruct' in body; only agent-tuned models)
breadth.reasoning_models: agent models with reasoning traces; reasoning not toggled (Section 3.6)
breadth.benchmarks: SWE-Bench-Verified (500 tasks), SWE-Bench-Pro (731 tasks), up to n=10 trajectories per task (Section 3.6)
breadth.label_source: execution of test suite and parser at each edit event (Section 2)
breadth.label_independence: labels computed externally from the agent by checking out program version
breadth.contamination_split: not present as release-date control; cross-benchmark transfer used as external validity
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUC; Brier score discussed with label imbalance (Limitations); no ECE found in grep
breadth.causal_intervention: not present; Limitations: 'Demonstrating causality would require steering ... we leave it to future work.'

claim: The paper positions itself against Ribeiro et al., Bui et al., and Vu et al. as single-step generation work, and reports no verbal-confidence comparison and no causal steering (decodability only).
stance_target: L2 novelty: probe-vs-verbal comparison remains unaddressed by this citer
quoted_support: Our claims are about what is represented, not about causal mechanisms.
scope_conditions: agentic SWE trajectories; Section on limitations
